EmailTemplate.name: Reactive-BT CORE EG Transition to MM
EmailTemplate.subject: Transition to Middle Market Service Team
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
CC all internal Insperity partners so they are aware of the change
Hello [Client Name],
We periodically review the complexity and strategic needs of your business to ensure the correct resources are aligned with your needs and goals. In keeping with Insperity's goal to provide you with the highest quality service appropriate to your growing company we will be transferring you to our Middle Market Service Team effective [insert date].
The Middle Market Service Team consists of Human Resources, Account Executive, and Payroll professionals dedicated to serving clients of your size and business needs. This transition reflects Insperity's ongoing commitment to providing. Insperity's experienced HR and Account Executive service professionals are dedicated to guiding and supporting your business objectives to help your organization achieve improved performance, productivity, and profitability.
As part of this transition, your new dedicated Insperity HR Specialist is [Insert Name], your new dedicated Account Executive is [Insert Name] and your new Payroll Specialist is [Insert Name].
[Insert Name], your Account Executive will connect with you in the several days. In the meantime, please find your new team's contact info below:
Account Executive Contact Name Account Executive Contact Info
HR Specialist Name HR Specialist Contact Info
Payroll Specialist Name Payroll Specialist Contact Info
Our teams have met and discussed all recent and past activity at your business to ensure a smooth transition. We remain committed to providing ongoing support to address any future needs or concerns you may have.
It has been a pleasure assisting you with your business needs. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to let me know.
Thank you
[signature]
